def parse_patch(data,prefix):
    # Split only on LF, retaining CR bytes and all content bytes in memory.

        current['base_span']={'start_gap':left,'end_gap':left+count,'is_insertion':count==0}
        out.append(current);payloads[hid]=(removed,added)
        current=None;events=[]
    for line in patch_lines:
        m=header.match(line)

            new_start=int(m[3]);new_count=int(m[4]) if m[4] is not None else 1
